POST /api/ds/dataset/{dataset}/portal token: dataset
sdk.apis().dszCreateCustomerPortal

Create Customer Portal

Creates a customer portal session for managing subscription and billing.

Request Parameters

Field Type Description
params.dataset string

Dataset identifier.
payload.locale string

Preferred locale for customer portal.
payload.return_url string

Return URL after customer portal session.

Response Payload

Field Type Description
payload.url string

Stripe customer portal URL.

Try It

return await sdk.apis().dszCreateCustomerPortal({
  params: {
    dataset: "",
  },
  payload: {
    locale: "",
    return_url: "",
  },
})
Wrap a call in inspect(...) to see the requests it makes.
